description: `council` (cli.py's cmd_council) seats a council (two distinct vendors, the floor `council.seat` needs — council.py's MINIMUM_COUNCILLORS), prints the roster, then refuses to convene without `--yes`: the heaviest path in the system is never a silent default. `--dry-run` takes the same roster but prints 'nothing was dispatched' instead; this scenario only exercises the refusal (`EXIT_ERROR`, dispatch.py's `cmd_council` never calls herdr at all before refusing).

home.config_toml:
[accounts.claude-personal]
kind = "claude"
config_dir_var = "CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR"
config_dir = "{{DIR:claude-home}}"
pool = "claude:personal"
command = "claude-personal"

[accounts.codex-work]
kind = "codex"
config_dir_var = "CODEX_HOME"
config_dir = "{{DIR:codex-home}}"
pool = "chatgpt:work"

[roles.council]
write_scope = "none"

[roles.council.models]
claude = "opus"
codex = "gpt-x"

[projects.sandbox]
path = "{{PROJECT:sandbox}}"

[projects.sandbox.chains]
council = ["claude-personal", "codex-work"]

stderr_contains: refusing to convene 2 agents without --yes. This is the heaviest path in the system.
